pages.text: You attempt to temper the Rampaging Axe using the ancient techniques of the Piglins, resulting in an axe wreathed in flames. You feel that this style suits you well as a Nether mage.
Retaining all the functions of the Rampaging Axe, this axe also sets creatures on fire and deals additional damage to burning targets.
Can be repaired with Cursed Metal Ingots on an Anvil.
